snippet.title: ASSETTO CORSA RALLY ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER
snippet.description:
Introducing Assetto Corsa Rally! 
created by the Supernova game studios in technical partnership with Kunos simulazioni.

Early Access Program starts November 13th 2025
Wishlist now on Steam.
https://505.games/ACRAnnounce

Special thanks to our partners for their support in the creation of this trailer:

Fanatec
Rseat
OMP
Bell
Sim Racing Expo
Syspack

For more information, visit our site: https://assettocorsa.gg/assetto-corsa-rally/
